strengths: Continuous fitted scalp coverage removes the exposed crown and helmet-band failures seen in rejected v7-v13 probes.
Fine continuous strand-group cards follow crown-to-nape great-circle paths and converge coherently into the low bun.
The same generator fits both the stable CC0 production template and the unrelated project-owned articulated human without target-specific coordinates.
limitations: Accepted only for medium and more distant shots; this mesh-card representation does not claim hero-close strand fidelity.
The bun and scalp are rigidly head-owned and do not yet provide secondary motion, flyaways, collision simulation, or wet-hair response.
The deliberately stylized flow groups can read as graphic highlights under hard close lighting and should not be framed as individual hair strands.
notes: V14 is accepted as reusable medium-shot pulled-back hair inventory. Earlier wide-card, striped, exposed-scalp, wire-bun, and dashed-card iterations remain rejected evidence and are not publication candidates.
